field_provenance.verified: Taken from the public listing (title, card, description, or schema.org fields).
field_provenance.calculated: Derived only from verified listing figures (for example price ÷ area).
field_provenance.estimated: Derived from OpenStreetMap, a locality geocode, or a documented proxy. Not a surveyed or official figure.

meta.traffic_method: Official Department of Highways traffic volumes were not matched to individual sites. Traffic potential is a 0–100 proxy from OSM road class, lanes (when tagged), distance to a major road, nearby major roads, and nearby industrial/commercial/institutional activity. meta.zoning_method: Zoning is not guessed. See the official DPT city-plan viewer: https://oneplan.dpt.go.th/
meta.disclaimer: This is a site-selection screening tool, not investment, legal, or engineering advice. Always verify the title deed (chanote), access rights, zoning, and on-the-ground conditions with a surveyor and the local authorities before making a decision.
